_note: relevant_markers are literal substrings (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised) that must appear in a chunk's own content for that chunk to count as relevant -- not chunk ids. Substring ground truth survives a change to chunk boundaries without needing to be relabelled by id. query_id prefixes name the query shape this case exercises: ID- (exact identifier lookup, lexical search should win), PARA- (paraphrased conceptual question, dense search should win), MIX- (a question combining an exact identifier with conceptual language, fusion should win).
